Workshop “First Steps in Research”

Our group has many years of extensive experience in the implementation of different Models in the research of mechanisms of cardiovascular diseases. This Workshop is meant to teach talented students how to develop their research skills and to persue their own projects.


Methods

  • Research fundamentals
  • Practicability of research methods
  • Planning experiments
  • Evaluation of risks and mitigations possibilities
  • Evaluation of the impact
  • Finding financial resources

Target Audience

Students (high-school and university)

Registration

The number of participants is limited. Tax fee for the workshop will be communicated.

Please bring your laptop or your tablet with you.

Please follow our website for more information.
